{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-openclaw-luna6-medium-seq0/frozen/seen/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ae4551d3.py",
 "content": "from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    row_groups = []
    start = 0
    for r in sep_rows + [h]:
        if start < r:
            row_groups.append(list(range(start, r)))
        start = r + 1
    col_groups = []
    start = 0
    for c in sep_cols + [w]:
        if start < c:
            col_groups.append(list(range(start, c)))
        start = c + 1
    excluded = set(sep_rows)  # separators are removed before color frequency counting
    excluded_cols = set(sep_cols)
    colors = Counter(grid[r][c] for r in range(h) if r not in excluded
                     for c in range(w) if c not in excluded_cols)
    background = colors.most_common(1)[0][0]
    other_colors = [color for color in colors if color != background]
    signal = max(other_colors, key=lambda color: colors[color]) if other_colors else background
    out = []
    for rs in row_groups:
        out_row = []
        for cs in col_groups:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] == signal for r in rs for c in cs)
            out_row.append(1 if count == 2 else background)
        out.append(out_row)
    return out
"
}
